source.section: III.D.30 (printed p.23, PDF p.30); context V.B.2 (PDF p.38)
source.quote_free_summary: After a qualifying injury or illness withdrawal once a Final has begun, the couple is awarded last place for each dance it did not dance; competitors must attend at least one-half hour before their program.

requirement: NOT IMPLEMENTED for a future NDCA profile and NOT applied universally: the NDCA last-place-per-dance exception applies only to a qualifying withdrawal after a Final begins and is not a general Scratch/No-show rule. Cross-reference OD08-NDCA-0001 (PR 840).
enforcement_point: Not built. NOT IMPLEMENTED; a blocker for activating the corresponding future governing-body profile. Studio/Custom behavior is unchanged.
interpretation_notes: Studio policy (no automatic last place) intentionally differs. This entry only records the non-universal scope; the withdrawal rule itself is OD08-NDCA-0001.
